facts.full: FROM THE HOST / Because, unlike some other Robin Hoods, I can speak with an English accent. / Robin of Loxley
facts.why: The quote is Robin's real line, said to Prince John when Robin barges into John's banquet to warn him about the taxes. Prince John hosts that banquet; Robin is the uninvited guest, so 'From the host' signs it to the wrong side of the table.

fix_note.text: Because, unlike some other Robin Hoods, I can speak with an English accent.

vibe.verdict: A proper Mel Brooks feast (toll rolls, Loxley and Bagel lox, the wild pig, Latrine's eyeball omelette, sacramental juice), let down a little by the same poster art printed twice and a stock price.
missing: That's a wild bore! (the punchline, pointing at Prince John)
Latrine: it used to be Shithouse (kept off for a family menu, but her name joke is the gag)
Ahchoo: it worked in Blazing Saddles
ideas: Swap the pork note 'A wild boar? No, that's a wild pig.' for 'Not a wild boar. That's a wild pig.' and put 'That's a wild bore' on the place card for Prince John
Swap the bottom still for a different TMDB still so the poster art does not print twice
Swap the place card line 'Seated by Maid Marian' for 'Key to Marian's Everlast lock, held'
